performance_case.causal_mechanism: Eliminating the fixed interpretation-runner-v1 to interpretation-runner-v2 root mismatch prevents a future positive V3 interpretation from stalling before preregistered hypothesis design.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may establish only static post-interpretation binding readiness and a bounded versioned closure. It cannot access outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, capacity, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital strategy experiment passes independent Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A false negative wastes the current forward evidence window and delays learning after a positive interpretation; a false positive could alter a frozen hypothesis contract after outcome access, so only versioned tooling closure is admissible.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The correction cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but removing a deterministic post-positive workflow stall reduces time to a credible strategy accept-or-reject decision without increasing variants or relaxing scientific gates.
